traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are implemented and verified:
- **Before Other Tags / After Other Tags / Mixed Positions**: Specific valid tests exercise traceability annotations before, after, and interleaved with @param/@returns lines. All pass, demonstrating correct parsing in all positions. - **Proper Termination & JSDoc Tag Detection**: The new helper `isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine` recognizes any JSDoc tag starting with `@` other than @story/@req/@supports. `processCommentLine` finalizes the current pending annotation when such a line is encountered, ensuring annotation values terminate at tag boundaries. - **Continuation Lines**: Continuations are only applied when there is a pending annotation and the line is not empty and not a non-traceability JSDoc tag; this enforces that only true continuation lines (not starting with @tag) extend multi-line values. - **Error Messages / No False Positives**: The prior bug (concatenating `@param` into the requirement ID) is covered by a valid test case `[REQ-NO-FALSE-POSITIVES]` which would fail if the parser still produced invalid IDs or errors. It passes, confirming the fix. Existing error message tests from earlier stories continue to pass. - **Preserve Multiline**: Dedicated test `[REQ-PRESERVE-MULTILINE] multi-line @story annotation before other JSDoc tags` ensures multi-line values are preserved correctly up to, but not including, subsequent JSDoc tags. - **Documentation**: The rule documentation now includes a clear "JSDoc coexistence" section with behavior description and an example that matches the story’s intent. - **Tests**: The test file explicitly maps to this story and its requirement IDs, and a full Jest run confirms all these tests pass. No additional unmet requirements were found in the story.
Based on code inspection, documentation, and passing targeted tests, this story is fully implemented and remains correct in the current codebase.
